children: German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil said on Tuesday that without taking on new debt, Germany cannot defend itself.
"It's like flying to the moon without a rocket," Klingbeil said, defending his 2027 draft budget in the lower house of parliament.
Germany is not investing in defence to wage war, he said, but rather to avoid experiencing war, adding that Russia's war does not stop at the borders of Ukraine.
"We will not be intimidated by (Russian President Vladimir) Putin," Klingbeil said.
